newsitem.title: USA: U.S. speaker to visit China, Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: U.S. speaker to visit China, Hong Kong.

text.p: U.S. House of Representatives Speaker Newt Gingrich will visit China, Hong Kong, Japan and South Korea at the end of March, his office said on Monday.

Gingrich and eight other House members will leave on March 23 and return to Washington on April 1 during the congressional Easter recess. They will visit both Beijing and Shanghai in China as well as Seoul, Tokyo and Hong Kong.
Other members of the delegation include Louisiana Republican Bob Livingston, the chairman of the House Appropriations Committee, and Michigan Democrat John Dingell, the senior member of the House.

"This trip will enable members to gain rare insights in these countries in a number of critical areas. Members will have many opportunities to share their views on economic development, human rights and several other crucial topics," Gingrich, a Georgia Republican, said in a statement.
